blurb: Day Block Brewing Company is a brewpub in downtown Minneapolis known for scratch-made pizzas, fresh ingredients, and creative flavor combinations. They offer hand-tossed dough pizzas, Wagyu burgers, wings, salads, and shareable plates. The venue features happy hour, weekend brunch, live music, and a dog-friendly patio.
extraNote: Happy hour excludes Stadium Event Days · Bands pay no cut of ticket or merchandise sales; sound engineer fee covered by ticket sales
